purpose: Current web intelligence enrichment for FGF Intelligence. These records are enrichment and source-aware context; they do not overwrite primary in-game UI evidence without explicit conflict resolution.

source_policy.tier_1: Official developer/game documentation and direct in-game evidence.
source_policy.tier_2: Strong tested community/wiki or official-announcement mirrors when the direct official page is not machine-readable.
source_policy.tier_3: Community guides/videos; useful for strategy enrichment but not canonical facts.
source_policy.schedule_rule: For Season 2, server-specific event timing must come from the in-game calendar; general cadence must not be converted into a date.

claims: Paths to Dominance is listed as a Major Event / Fortress Conquest.
The current event index lists its duration as 24 hours.
The current Champions page presents Energy Type alignment and synergy as core mechanics.
The current page visibly lists Kinetic, Beam and Ion champion groups and role/stat notes for the displayed champions.
The page advertises a 51-champion corpus, but the machine-readable page capture does not expose all 51 entries; do not invent the missing roster.
Siwenna has Border Region systems at levels 8-9 and Core Region systems at levels 10-12.
Paths to Dominance, Dominion Warzone and Commerce Guild Duel persist on the Siwenna map.
Magnetic Storm Resistance affects combat in Siwenna.
In rally combat, the rally leader's Resistance is used for all fleet members in the rally, according to the guide.
Energy Types are Beam, Kinetic and Ionic.
Beam is strong against Kinetic and weak against Ionic; Kinetic is strong against Ionic and weak against Beam; Ionic is strong against Beam and weak against Kinetic.
Having the Energy Type advantage grants a 5% damage boost.
Matching 2 Champions to the Flagship Energy Type gives +10% ATK/DEF/INT; matching 3 gives +20% ATK/DEF/INT.
Champion skills activate left-to-right in formation order.
The September 9 guide documented the then-current Epoch of Fusion Seed prerequisite as 60% Combat Craft Modification progress.
Energy Core 33 unlocks the fourth Battle Queue.
The guide documents specialization trees for Kinetic, Beam and Ion.
sources.lifecycle: The 60% Epoch prerequisite is historical/superseded by the September 22 hot update below.

claims: Shadowfront Commerce Guild rewards were increased.
Weapon Prism was added to the Discount Shop.
Epoch of Fusion Seed Combat Craft Modification prerequisite was reduced from 60% to 40%.
The announcement says the listed changes were subject to change.
sources.lifecycle: Current unless superseded by a later developer announcement.

claims: With Season 2, event schedules vary more between servers.
The developer stopped publishing a universal social-media event calendar and directs players to the in-game calendar for server-specific timing.
For Servers 1001-1016, the published S2 notes say Top 100 is in Weeks 1, 2 and 4, Guild Duel starts Week 3, Dominion Warzone starts Week 6, and later event schedules can differ by server.
Paths to Dominance point rules were optimized so PvP battles in Level 9 star systems grant event points.
Prince's Decrees received increased use counts.
Prince buff effects and cooldowns no longer reset when Paths to Dominance begins; bounty effects still clear on reset.

conflict_rules.older_community_sources: some older community pages describe a 7-day political/buff cycle
conflict_rules.resolution: Use the primary supplied in-game UI and current wiki 24-hour event duration for the competition itself. Treat the 7-day wording as an older/community cycle model unless current in-game evidence shows otherwise.

conflict_rules.historical: 60% Combat Craft Modification progress in the Sep 9 official guide
conflict_rules.resolution: 40% is current; preserve 60% as superseded historical evidence.

planner_implications: Paths to Dominance planning must distinguish the 24-hour competition window from any post-competition Trader Prince/appointment effects shown by the live server UI.
For S2, never calculate a calendar date from the bi-weekly cadence alone; require the player's in-game calendar/server state.
For S2 combat planning, collect player Resistance and rally-leader Resistance context before making a rally recommendation.
For fleet planning, use Energy Type countering, 2/3-Champion synergy and left-to-right skill order as deterministic mechanics from the official Fleet Power guide.
When an exact Champion roster/level is missing, return roster-required alternatives rather than inventing a combination.
Keep official, current wiki, community strategy and observed in-game evidence as separate provenance layers.
